description: Provides capability to search, create, transition, and comment on Jira issues via host-brokered secrets.
systemExtension: Use 'jira_search_issues' to query issues, 'jira_create_issue' to file tasks, 'jira_transition_issue' to advance workflows, and 'jira_add_comment' to record progress.

tools.description: Queries Jira issues using Jira Query Language (JQL).
tools.inputSchemaJson: {"type":"object","properties":{"jql":{"type":"string","description":"The JQL search string"},"max_results":{"type":"integer","description":"Maximum number of issues to return"}},"required":["jql"]}
tools.name: jira_search_issues

tools.description: Creates a new issue inside a specified Jira project.
tools.name: jira_create_issue

tools.description: Transitions an existing Jira issue into a new status (e.g. In Progress, Done, Backlog).
tools.inputSchemaJson: {"type":"object","properties":{"issue_key":{"type":"string"},"transition_id":{"type":"string","description":"Transition ID or target status name (e.g. In Progress, Done)"}},"required":["issue_key","transition_id"]}
tools.name: jira_transition_issue

tools.description: Adds a comment to an existing Jira issue.
tools.name: jira_add_comment

tools.description: Send an SSRF-safe HTTP GET/HEAD request with host-brokered secrets.
tools.inputSchemaJson: {"type":"object","properties":{"url":{"type":"string","description":"Target absolute URL or relative path if base-url secret is present"},"headers":{"type":"object","description":"Optional headers map"},"timeout_ms":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["url"]}
tools.name: http_get

tools.description: Send an SSRF-safe HTTP POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE request with host-brokered secrets.
tools.inputSchemaJson: {"type":"object","properties":{"url":{"type":"string","description":"Target absolute URL or relative path if base-url secret is present"},"method":{"type":"string","description":"HTTP method like POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE"},"headers":{"type":"object","description":"Optional headers"},"body":{"type":"string","description":"Optional raw body"},"json":{"type":"object","description":"Optional JSON body"},"timeout_ms":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["url"]}
tools.name: http_write
